reviews.title: Absolutely fantastic tour!
reviews.text: Our guide was knowledgeable, friendly, and showed us the real Addis Ababa. The National Museum was incredible—seeing Lucy in person was a highlight of our trip. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.title: Perfect for our layover
reviews.text: Perfect for our 8-hour layover. Pickup was on time, the guide was excellent, and we saw all the highlights without feeling rushed. Great value for money.
reviews.author: James L.

reviews.tourName: Debre Libanos & Portuguese Bridge Day Trip
reviews.title: Best tour we've ever taken!
reviews.text: The Debre Libanos monastery and Portuguese Bridge were breathtaking. Our guide knew so much about the history and wildlife. We saw gelada baboons up close!
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.title: Comprehensive and enriching
reviews.text: The full-day tour covered everything: National Museum, Holy Trinity Cathedral, Mercato, Entoto Park, and the coffee ceremony. Our guide was passionate and knowledgeable. Lunch was delicious!
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.tourName: Tiya, Adadi Mariam & Melka Kunture UNESCO Day Trip
reviews.title: Archaeological wonder
reviews.text: The Tiya stelae were mesmerizing—so mysterious and ancient. Adadi Mariam church was beautiful, and Melka Kunture gave us a glimpse into prehistoric times. Excellent guide!
reviews.author: Anna K.

reviews.title: Nature lover's paradise
reviews.text: The forest was pristine and peaceful. We saw Colobus monkeys, endemic birds, and a beautiful waterfall. Our naturalist guide was incredibly knowledgeable. Highly recommend for nature lovers!
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.title: Perfect family day out
reviews.text: Our kids loved swimming in the crater lakes! The resort facilities were great, lunch was delicious, and the drive was scenic. Perfect for families seeking relaxation.
reviews.author: Lisa H.

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text: We booked the full-day tour and it exceeded all expectations. The coffee ceremony was a highlight—our guide explained the three rounds and their meanings. Felt like honored guests!
reviews.author: Robert W.
